title: Tignes Catalog Curation
summary: Reviewed Tignes linked-domain pass scope against official Tignes ski-area wording and official shared Tignes - Val d'Isere ticket prices. Added the Tignes - Val d'Isere pass as the default regional-network product while leaving local terrain, stay-base, rental, and exact season-window enrichment unresolved for later curation.

changes.after: Also valid across the linked Tignes - Val d'Isere ski area beyond the modeled Tignes ski-area entity, including Val d'Isere terrain.

evidence.evidence_summary: Official Tignes ski-area page names the linked ski area as Tignes - Val d'Isere.
evidence.normalization_note: Normalized official linked-domain heading into a stable Snowcast pass-product display name.

evidence.source_value: 300 km of linked pistes in the alpine domain
evidence.evidence_summary: Official Tignes page describes the product-relevant skiing domain as linked Tignes - Val d'Isere terrain rather than only local Tignes terrain.
evidence.normalization_note: Normalized linked-domain validity to regional_network because Val d'Isere is outside this destination's modeled local ski-area ids.

evidence.source_value: The whole of the Tignes - Val d'Isere ski area becomes accessible when conditions allow.
evidence.evidence_summary: Official Tignes ski-area page frames the linked domain as the main alpine skiing product for Tignes planning.
evidence.normalization_note: Default means representative adult/default product for planning display, not a purchase recommendation.

evidence.source_value: Tignes ski area with linked Tignes - Val d'Isere domain
evidence.evidence_summary: The pass product covers the modeled Tignes ski-area entity and additional external Val d'Isere access.
evidence.normalization_note: Only local modeled ski_area_ids are stored; Val d'Isere is summarized as external validity.

evidence.source_value: 300 km of linked pistes in the alpine domain
evidence.evidence_summary: Official Tignes page supports an external validity summary covering linked Val d'Isere terrain.
evidence.normalization_note: External linked terrain is summarized rather than copied into local Tignes ski-area facts.

evidence.source_title: Ski passes Tignes - Val d'Isere and Val d'Isere prices
evidence.evidence_summary: Official Val d'Isere ticket page lists adult Tignes - Val d'Isere 1-day, 3-day, and 6=7-day prices for winter 2025/26.
evidence.normalization_note: Used the official shared-domain ticket page for representative adult/default prices because Tignes and Val d'Isere share the same pass product.

evidence.source_value: Official Tignes linked-domain scope and official shared pass prices.
evidence.evidence_summary: Official scope and price evidence supports moving lift_pass_products from needs_source to verified_with_adjustment.
evidence.normalization_note: Trust status summarizes linked-domain product scope and representative adult/default prices.

validation_commands: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-config pytest tests/test_catalog_validation.py tests/test_loader.py -q
ranking_comparison_summary: Not run for this pass-product-only curation. Current production ranking does not consume lift_pass_products directly.
unresolved_caveats: The 300 km Tignes - Val d'Isere linked-domain terrain is modeled only as pass-product scope; this PR does not copy it into local Tignes ski-area piste facts.
Reviewed sources did not provide local-only Tignes piste kilometers, lift count, or blue/red/black kilometer splits suitable for the current single ski-area entity.
Stay-base coordinates, nearest-lift distance, lodging price, rental price, quality tier, and supported skill levels remain estimate-backed pending a dedicated stay-base/rental sweep.
Exact season windows remain unchanged; the linked-domain season needs a separate season-window curation decision.
